title: OnePlus 16 sounds great; too bad you won't be able to buy it
summary: A Weibo leak from Digital Chat Station sketches the OnePlus 16 as a promising upgrade with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro and modest design changes. Despite promising hardware, OnePlus intends to limit availability after announcing exits from the US and European markets, refocusing on China and parts of India. The result could be a compelling flagship that remains unavailable to many international customers.
content:
A new leak paints a picture of the OnePlus 16, which will be tantalizingly out of reach for the brand’s loyal customers from around the globe.

Leaker Digital Chat Station details the OnePlus 16 in a post on Weibo, describing the device as similar in overall design, but with some bumped-up specs including the new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro.

Some of the specs mentioned here include: (the leak did not list a full specification sheet in the original post), but the key point highlighted was the upgraded flagship chipset and incremental design continuity rather than a total redesign.

While there’s a lot still left in the dark, that already sounds great for performance and headline specs.

Sadly, though, this will be the first OnePlus flagship skipping out on the rest of the globe following the brand’s announcement that it will pull out of the US and markets in Europe, instead focusing on China and, to an extent, India – though it sounds like India is next on the chopping block.

That strategic retrenchment means the OnePlus 16, even if it arrives with competitive hardware, is likely to be difficult or impossible to buy officially in many regions. For long-time fans who associate the brand with the "Never Settle" ethos, the shift is a stark change.

RIP OnePlus.
